notes.title: Firefighting Simulator: Ignite – Hotfix #2 is now live!
notes.content:
[h2][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45535639/deccd3a85dbaf0fe99a2b15b00bf0772d4d8d1b5.png"][/img][/h2][h3][b]Attention, Firefighters![/b][/h3][p][/p][p]The fire never sleeps — and neither do we!
Hot on the heels of our first update, [b]Hotfix #2[/b] has rushed to the scene to tackle even more issues you’ve reported.[/p][p]This update includes several fixes and improvements to keep your firefighting experience running smoothly.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]Changelog – Hotfix #2[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Fixed several translation issues[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed crash when joining the same multiplayer lobby more then once[/p][/*][*][p]Improved AI Firetruck Navigation[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue in the vehicle selection for Mission "Just Tuning The Engine"[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue in the Mission "Stuck at the Office" which prevent some areas from being extinguished[/p][/*][*][p]Improved general game stability[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Thank you for all your feedback and reports — you’re helping us make [i]Firefighting Simulator: Ignite[/i] the best it can be![/p][p][/p][p]Stay safe out there,[/p][p][b]Your Firefighting Simulator Team 🧑‍🚒[/b][/p][p] [/p]

notes.title: The First Modding Missions are here!
notes.content:
[h3][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45535639/82b79e011d850ad76e0022ffeaad49e723ec329b.png"][/img][/h3][h3][b]Attention, Firefighters![/b][/h3][p]We’re excited to announce that the very first mods for [b]Firefighting Simulator: Ignite[/b] are here![/p][p]Since the Release last week, our amazing community has already created over 50+ mods (okay, some of them might have been created by our devs, but Shhh..!). We’re blown away by everyone’s creativity and passion. 🙌 15 of these mods are also already available on consoles, bringing new missions and experiences to players everywhere.[/p][p][b]Check out the mods here:[/b] [url="https://mod.io/g/ffsignite"]https://mod.io/g/ffsignite[/url][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45535639/55f570e810f02d976584d4794dd3c1e0072f39e4.png"][/img][/p][h3][b]❤️ A Huge Thank You to Our Community.[/b][/h3][p]We want to give a massive thank you to every creator and player who has jumped into the world of modding. Your creations and your dedication are helping to make Firefighting Simulator: Ignite even more exciting and dynamic.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45535639/7ba66c9f7667de7c8ab9b6925cc81b4970847c63.png"][/img][/p][h3][b]🕒 Why Mods take a bit longer on Consoles.[/b][/h3][p]To ensure mods on consoles are safe, stable, and fun, each one must be manually checked and approved before it goes live.[/p][p]Because of this, there will always be a slight delay between when a mod appears on PC and when it becomes available on consoles. Our team is carefully reviewing each mod step by step, so if you don’t see a particular mod on console right away, rest assured – as long as it doesn't cause any trouble or violates any rules, it’s on the way![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45535639/620b35ca26903754e2d2e36a77a260226a50e44b.png"][/img][/p][h3]🎮 [b]Start playing Community Missions now.[/b][/h3][p]Head over to the Mods section in-game and check out the very first community-created missions – or jump in and create your own![/p][p]Once again, thank you for making this possible – we can’t wait to see what you’ll create next. 🔥
[/p][p]Stay safe out there,[/p][p][b]Your Firefighting Simulator Team[/b] 🧑‍🚒[/p]

notes.title: Upcoming Hotfix #1
notes.content:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45535639/7af657213dc1a2fddea7977511da1a09027bd930.png"][/img][/p][h3][b]Attention, Firefighters![/b][/h3][p]
First off, a huge thank you to everyone for playing Firefighting Simulator: Ignite and sharing your feedback over the last few days. It's been incredible to see how you've been engaging with the game and helping us identify issues that need attention.

We're currently preparing to release a first hotfix early next week. Because this update needs to be coordinated across all platforms for crossplay, we don't have an exact timing for this.

The main focus of this hotfix is addressing as many crashes as possible.

Please note that the download size will be around 25GB, due to changes in compression.
[/p][p][b]Here is a tentative list of fixes:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed issue where conscious victims would not properly enter the aerial cage when following the player[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed input issues on vehicle interactions (Siren, Yelp) while driving[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an area that was almost impossible to extinguish in the mission "The Kiosk"[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed holes in destroyed residential roofs: It is no longer possible to fall through and get stuck[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed several translation issues[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed issues with AI firetruck obstacle detection[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a compression issue on Intel 13th and 14th gen. CPUs. This has sadly led to most content being compressed again inflating the patch file size. We are sorry for the inconvenience =([/p][/*][*][p]Improved general game stability[/p][/*][/list][p]
[/p][p][b]Known Issues & Workarounds[/b][/p][p]
While we work on these fixes, here are some temporary solutions for common issues:
[/p][list][*][p]Extremely bright screen on PC: Try changing the Quality Preset in your graphics settings. You should be able to re-apply your original settings afterwards.[/p][/*][*][p]If you are experiencing crashes in the mission "Crashing the Party", try skipping the approach when starting the mission. This can help to avoid the crash.[/p][/*][*][p]Severe FPS drops when using foam with FSR Frame Generation enabled: Disable FSR Frame Generation in the graphics settings.[/p][/*][*][p]Crashes related to GPU drivers: It may help to launch the game with the following startup option: "-clearPSODriverCache". If your problem persists, remove this option again as it will slowdown the game start.[/p][/*][/list][p]
Thank you for your patience and continued support as we work to improve the gameplay experience!

[b]Your Firefighting Simulator Team 🧑‍🚒[/b][/p]

notes.title: Firefighting Simulator: Ignite – Mission Editor
notes.content:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45535639/74110de07676cdd7c4f90c476963243f9f0843e7.jpg"][/img][/p][h3][b]Attention, Firefighters![/b][/h3][p]
The PC versions of Firefighting Simulator: Ignite on Steam and the Epic Games Store include an integrated Mission Editor which enables you to create your own missions and to make them available for other players via Mod.io.

[b]Watch our Mission Editor Intro Trailer here:
[/b]
[/p][previewyoutube="E8mqfmcKWdY;full"][/previewyoutube][p]

After starting the Mission Editor via the game’s main menu, you can choose one of the available random missions of the game as a pre-set and afterwards edit it according your needs. You are able to replace or edit nearly everything within the building, set the starting points of the fire/s, place explosives, place victims and furnishings or even replace the pictures hanging on the walls. For some funny special effects, you can also edit the size of objects if you want to! So, it is totally up to you if you want to create a super exciting or challenging mission, a hell of fires or absolutely crazy things to have fun with!

Please note that creators have to set their modding missions to public on Mod.io to make them downloadable for others. After downloading a modding mission via Mod.io it will become available in a dedicated section within the overview of available missions at the button of the game’s missions list. From here you can start and play it whenever you want to. Depending on the chosen pre-set a modding mission is based on, it can take place on different location on the map. Where exactly will be chosen by random after starting the mission.


💥 [b]Modding Missions on Mod.io can be found here:[/b] 💥
[/p][p][url="https://mod.io/g/ffsignite"]https://mod.io/g/ffsignite[/url][/p][p]


🔥 [b]A detailed Mission Editor Guide for creators is available here:[/b] 🔥
[/p][p][url="https://mod.io/g/ffsignite/r/mod-creation-and-upload-guide"]https://mod.io/g/ffsignite/r/mod-creation-and-upload-guide[/url][/p][p]


🚨 [b]For discussions about modding missions here on Steam please visit...[/b] 🚨
[/p][p][url="https://steamcommunity.com/app/1669480/discussions/2/"]https://steamcommunity.com/app/1669480/discussions/2/[/url][/p][p]

So, what are you waiting for?!? Let’s go and start creating your first modding mission! We are already looking forward to your creations!


[b]Your Firefighting Simulator Team 🧑‍🚒
[/b]


[b]Note #1: Modding Missions in Multiplayer[/b]
[i]To be able to play modding missions in multiplayer, each of the players have to install the modding mission first. If one or more players haven’t installed it, the mod won’t appear in the list of modding missions![/i]

[b]Note #2: Availability of Modding Missions on PS5 and Xbox Series X|S[/b]
[i]Because of security rules, on consoles modding missions won’t become available automatically after a creator uploaded and set them to public. On consoles you can only see modding mission that got tested and greenlighted by us. We will check Mod.io for new modding missions regularly and try to greenlight as many of them as possible (as long as they work fine and meet the rules). However, we ask for your understanding that this may take some time and that we probably won’t be able to test and approve every modding mission.[/i][/p]

notes.title: 🔥 Into the Flames – The Mission Walkthrough Trailer is Here!
notes.content:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45535639/1bd1a1f5939fcc9ec8778fe9a2797570315d5aed.png"][/img][/p][h3][b]Attention, Firefighters![/b][/h3][p]
The alarm is ringing, and this time it’s a big one. During the Future Games Show Gamescom Showcase, we unveiled our brand-new Mission Walkthrough Trailer – and it’s live now![/p][p][b] 📺 Watch the full mission walkthrough trailer here:  [/b][/p][previewyoutube="OqOfD9CK3iU;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45535639/942e9607a6c728d8757f2eba4bb6676334fbd65e.png"][/img][/p][h3][b]🏬 The Heart of the City.[/b][/h3][p]
In Oakridge City, a routine shopping day turns into chaos when a fire breaks out in the heart of the mall. Thick smoke fills the air, visibility plummets, and the crowd’s safe exit is anything but certain. Many manage to escape, but some remain trapped — unconscious victims hidden deep inside and others stranded high on the rooftop.[/p][p] [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45535639/07106ef604ead6cad5513540751132d5b475b27b.png"][/img][/p][h3][b]🚑 Rescue is the Priority.[/b][/h3][p]
Every mission starts with one goal above all: get everyone out alive. Guide conscious survivors to safety, carry unconscious victims through danger, and keep your head clear under pressure. Your choices matter — hesitation could cost lives.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45535639/b0a9bbb922b7290211ca75999ec6e597c8063842.png"][/img][/p][h3][b]🔥 A Fire That Fights Back.[/b][/h3][p]
This isn’t a simple blaze. Electrical fires spark unpredictably, grease fires burn hotter and faster, and both demand different tactics. You’ll need to adapt, switching gear and extinguishing methods on the fly to gain the upper hand.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45535639/380a879a1f439b6f0b6566991e9aa835b9e423a0.png"][/img][/p][h3][b]🎤 Live at gamescom – The Ignite Showcase.[/b][/h3][p]
At gamescom 2025, developer Manuel joined GametechUK on stage for the [b]Firefighting Simulator: Ignite Showcase[/b], streamed live online for fans around the world. The event offered an exclusive deep dive into the game and revealed exciting first details about the upcoming [b]Summer Camp DLC[/b].
[/p][p][b]📺Watch the livestream here:[/b][/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://www.youtube.com/live/gxNsKuXtNM8?si=KkXBbGGxl4Yd4Cbg"][/dynamiclink] [/p][p][/p][p] 
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45535639/b1883d834bbf9f5ec4807d23e2ce2c6a369d3238.jpg"][/img][/p][p][b]☀️ First Look at the Summer Camp DLC.[/b][/p][p]
Coming in Q4 2025, the Summer Camp DLC delivers an entirely new environment far from the city streets. Wooden cabins, a sprawling lake, and open-air activities set the scene — until flames break out and the race to save lives begins. The pack is part of the Year 1 Season Pass.[/p][p] [/p][p]Firefighting Simulator: Ignite launches September 9, 2025. Pre-order now to secure the Fire Station Companion Pack as a free pre-order bonus and be ready to deploy on day one.

Stay safe out there,

[b]Your Firefighting Simulator Team 🧑‍🚒[/b][/p][p] [/p]

notes.title: Rolling in Hot: Meet the Rosenbauer Fleet
notes.content:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45535639/72b7ce4ec19d7659bb158452ff07214192199036.png"][/img][/p][h3][b]Attention all heroes – here’s your first briefing!
[/b][/h3][p]Soon, the streets of Oakridge City will be your responsibility as you gear up to fight fires and save lives. In high-stakes emergencies, having the right equipment can mean everything –[b] [/b]and that starts with your fire truck.
[/p][p]For [b]Firefighting Simulator: Ignite[/b], we’ve once again partnered with [b]Rosenbauer America[/b] to bring you a fleet of licensed, faithfully reproduced fire trucks, built for action and engineered for realism. Whether it’s a towering aerial platform or a compact, quick-response pumper, each truck has been recreated visually down to the last detail.
[/p][p]Today, we’re proud to introduce the full lineup of Rosenbauer engines you’ll be commanding in your fight against the flames. Dressed in their sleek black-and-red livery, these rigs aren’t just eye-catching – they’re lifesaving.[/p][p]Let’s meet the fleet.[/p][p] [/p][h3]🔥 [b]Meet the Rosenbauer TP3.[/b][/h3][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45535639/7fe5ec1527a44c5b2dafd8443dbe65361d1fccd1.jpg"][/img][/p][p]The [b]Rosenbauer TP3™[/b] is a short-wheelbase truck featuring a powerful top-mounted pumper enabling rapid and efficient firefighting.[/p][list][*][p]Apparatus Height: 10’[/p][/*][*][p]Apparatus Length: 32’3”[/p][/*][*][p]Water Tank Capacity: 750 G[/p][/*][*][p]GPM: 1,500 GPM[/p][/*][/list][p]The Rosenbauer TP3 was first introduced in 2016 and expanded Rosenbauer’s Tactical Pump (TP) lineup, addressing the growing need for compact, high-performance vehicles in both urban and rural firefighting operations.[/p][p] [/p][h3]🐍 [b]Meet the Rosenbauer Viper.[/b][/h3][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45535639/68f54152dd24d182dd35fe18ed13f486daa0195f.jpg"][/img][/p][p]The [b]Rosenbauer Viper™[/b] features a powerful pump with the addition of a long reaching 78’ ladder for aerial access.[/p][list][*][p]Apparatus Height: 11’2”[/p][/*][*][p]Apparatus Length: 37’8”[/p][/*][*][p]Water Tank Capacity: 500 G[/p][/*][*][p]GPM: 1,500 GPM[/p][/*][/list][p]First introduced in 2005, the Viper combines advanced maneuverability with significant height access, making it ideal for fighting fires in tall buildings, performing rescues, and providing elevated water streams in complex firefighting scenarios.[/p][p] [/p][h3]🦖 [b]Meet the Rosenbauer T-Rex.[/b][/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45535639/2ad449e90606bbc86f9d6e14b5d9948ef747cdcc.jpg"][/img][/p][p]The [b]Rosenbauer T-Rex™[/b], equipped with a combination telescopic and articulating boom, is the fastest and most powerful articulating platform in the industry.[/p][list][*][p]Apparatus Height: 11’10”[/p][/*][*][p]Apparatus Length: 41’6”[/p][/*][*][p]Water Tank Capacity: 500 G[/p][/*][*][p]GPM: 2,000 GPM[/p][/*][/list][p]First introduced in 2008, the T-Rex’s far reach makes it ideal for high-rise rescues, elevated fire suppression, and complex urban scenarios. Its unique design allows it to access tight spaces while maintaining stability and reach.[/p][p] [/p][h3]🧰 [b]Meet the Rosenbauer Walk-In Rescue.[/b][/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45535639/c319ece1e9c257d68efcba36990939c15e224691.jpg"][/img][/p][p]The [b]Rosenbauer Walk-In Rescue™[/b] carries equipment and features an aisle down the center of the vehicle, providing ample space for firefighters and other emergency responders.[/p][list][*][p]Apparatus Height: 12’[/p][/*][*][p]Apparatus Length: 49’2”[/p][/*][/list][p]The Rosenbauer Walk-In Rescue was introduced in the early 2000s. Its customizable nature and versatility make it a critical asset for fire departments and emergency teams handling a variety of complex rescue scenarios with larger teams.[/p][p] [/p][h3]⚡ [b]Meet the Rosenbauer RTX.[/b][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45535639/e31a729603d44da285a07a606700672a51783f69.jpg"][/img][/h3][p]The [b]Rosenbauer RTX™[/b] is an electric fire truck featuring an innovative redesign of a pumper truck from chassis to engine, while offering powerful digital tools to support the firefighters on site.[/p][list][*][p]Apparatus Height: 9’6”[/p][/*][*][p]Apparatus Length: 28’6”[/p][/*][*][p]Water Tank Capacity: 750 G[/p][/*][*][p]GPM: 1,500 GPM[/p][/*][/list][p]The Rosenbauer RTX was first introduced in 2021, marking a significant step toward sustainability in the firefighting industry, without compromising practicality nor performance.[/p][p] [/p][h3]💥 [b]Meet the Rosenbauer Cobra.[/b][/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45535639/3e750825c3e0be043e848c54eace4b6fe76dab76.jpg"][/img][/p][p]The [b]Rosenbauer 100’MM Cobra™[/b] is a powerful pumper truck with an additional mid-mounted platform providing a far reaching and secure basket for gaining access and retrieving victims.[/p][list][*][p]Apparatus Height: 10’8”[/p][/*][*][p]Apparatus Length: 46’8”[/p][/*][*][p]Water Tank Capacity: 500 G[/p][/*][*][p]GPM: 2,000 GPM[/p][/*][/list][p]The Rosenbauer Cobra 100’ was first introduced in the mid 2000s, offering fire departments a reliable, high-performance solution for aerial firefighting and rescue needs.[/p][p] [/p][h3]🚨 [b]Meet the Rosenbauer Roadrunner.[/b][/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45535639/e4d61cff43e17033f8ca72d47a5c4d1997738c53.jpg"][/img][/p][p]The [b]Rosenbauer Roadrunner™[/b] is a multi-purpose apparatus offering the firepower of a full pumper combined with the reach of an aerial, featuring a high-powered wide sweeping nozzle capable of dousing fires from any angle.[/p][list][*][p]Apparatus Height: 12’3”[/p][/*][*][p]Apparatus Length: 34’[/p][/*][*][p]Water Tank Capacity: 500 G[/p][/*][*][p]GPM: 1,250 GPM[/p][/*][/list][p]The Rosenbauer Roadrunner was first introduced in the 1990s, offering a cost-effective and versatile solution for fire departments that need both ground-level and elevated firefighting capabilities.[/p][p] [/p][h3][b]🧯What’s your Go-To Fire Truck?[/b][/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45535639/a1d21cbcdf81a6a2071ce2c105cc4421973197e7.jpg"][/img][/p][p]From the nimble TP3 Pumper to the cutting-edge RTX electric fire truck, each [b]Rosenbauer America[/b] truck in [b]Firefighting Simulator: Ignite[/b] is built to handle the heat – literally. Which truck are you most excited to jump into?[/p][p] [/p][h3][b]🧑‍🚒 Join the Squad.

notes.title: No One Left Behind – The Rescue Trailer is live!
notes.content:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45535639/d28faa462c8d2e269b421cf837c75cfd87ff1394.png"][/img][/p][h3][b]Attention all heroes![/b][/h3][p]We’re proud to reveal the next big beat [i]for Firefighting Simulator: Ignite[/i] – our brand-new [b]Rescue Trailer[/b] just premiered during the [b]Games Forged in Germany Showcase[/b]![/p][p]This intense, atmospheric trailer dives into the heart of what matters most on every callout: [b]saving lives[/b].[/p][p]Set during a high-stakes nightclub mission filled with hazards, limited visibility, and numerous victims, this trailer plunges you right into the heart-pounding urgency of a real rescue mission.
[/p][h3][b]📺 Watch the trailer here:[/b][/h3][h3][/h3][previewyoutube="YmbBv9wgVzk;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][p]The dispatch call says it all: You need to be fast, you need to be efficient, and you need to be at your best.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45535639/d2587be27765068ef6af015b05e2af2fb3abfa8c.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3]🚑 [b]No One Left Behind.[/b][/h3][p]In [i]Firefighting Simulator: Ignite[/i], victim rescue is always the highest priority. Fires can trap civilians quickly, and heavy smoke can make it nearly impossible to see. As a firefighter, it’s your duty to locate, guide, and carry every person to safety.[/p][p]Victims can be found in different states: Conscious and unconscious. Sometimes, the only way to locate victims is by listening closely – shouts or coughing might be all you have to go on.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45535639/ce5500c242b8fa8d1bf0fc365630b628f7b9c254.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3]🧭 [b]Guide the Way to Safety.[/b][/h3][p]Once located, conscious victims need to be lead to safety. You’re not just fighting fire – you’re guiding people through one of the most dangerous moments of their lives.[/p][p]Unconscious victims are more vulnerable. Pick them up and carry them through smoke-filled corridors, down ladders, or through broken windows – whatever it takes to get them to the designated rescue area, where medics take over.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45535639/061b6df273808f3a242784c6b508917a4d4184d2.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3]🪜 [b]Up the Ladder.[/b][/h3][p]Some rescues can’t be done from the ground. Use vehicles with aerial ladders and platforms to reach victims in upper floors or balconies. The platforms can carry up to three people at once: one firefighter, one conscious victim following, and one unconscious victim being carried.[/p][p]It might be a tight fit, but it can make all the difference in a rescue under pressure.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45535639/57757a65f95db19db31b73ed22d9421d270f0361.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3]🧑‍🚒 [b]Your Mission isn’t over until Everyone’s out.[/b][/h3][p]Every mission in Firefighting Simulator: Ignite has one goal above all: rescue every victim. Whether it’s through thick smoke, collapsing structures, or rising flames, you and your squad must search every room and clear the building.
[/p][p]Only when every life has been accounted for can the mission be completed.
[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45535639/7a7bf3695cb476cdb1a1bbca22961731ac0fe0bc.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3]🚨 [b]Join the Squad.[/b][/h3][p][b]Pre-order today[/b] and be ready to deploy the moment the alarm rings:

notes.title: Bring your Squad – the Co-op Gameplay Reveal Trailer is live!
notes.content:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45535639/064e07359229b32c8fa7ee51cef58ba5f1206ada.png"][/img]
[b]Attention all heroes! [/b]

The wait is over – our brand-new [b]Co-op Gameplay Reveal Trailer[/b] just dropped during the [b]Future Games Show Summer Showcase[/b]! 🔥

Catch your first look at co-op firefighting in action right here: 

[/p][previewyoutube="B2KE-ov2BEY;full"][/previewyoutube][p]

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45535639/7e8fbc00cb769df63d8a214981d5389eed277418.jpg"][/img]
[/p][h3][b]🤝 Squad Goals.[/b][/h3][p]
Whether you’re gearing up for a mission callout with up to four players online, or heading in supported by NPC squadmates, teamwork is at the heart of every operation. Your squad will strategically deploy tools and interact dynamically with the environment to fight fires efficiently. Every callout brings fresh challenges that demand adaptability and problem-solving skills.

With full[b] crossplay support[/b], crews from any platform can join forces, while the [b]built-in voice chat [/b]ensures smooth coordination and precise task division. 


[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45535639/211b98711962042a5e8cfe58cf5abb11a655992b.jpg"][/img]
[/p][h3][b]🏠 Lobby up at the Fire Station.[/b][/h3][p]
It all starts at the [b]Oakridge City Fire Station[/b] – your mission hub where you’ll hang out, squad up, and hop into your fire truck of choice to reach the incident scene. 

Choose your mission and get ready to roll – when the alarm sounds,[b] every second counts. 
[/b]


[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45535639/cfeef88da19969abc9c917b4d2057868b07213fc.jpg"][/img]
[/p][h3][b]🔥 Enter the Scene.[/b][/h3][p]
Respond to emergencies in [b]officially licensed Rosenbauer America vehicles[/b], and work together to rescue civilians, manage hazards, and stop the spread of fire using advanced firefighting tactics.

Sometimes, you'll need to gain access by force. Locked doors, windows, and walls can be breached using tools like axes, Halligan bars, or circular saws. Saws will also come in handy as ventilation tools: cut holes in ceilings or garage walls to release dangerous smoke buildup.


[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45535639/cc4db45658b27166f8da9d960f72aac0059ae431.jpg"][/img]
[/p][h3][b]🚑 No one left behind.[/b][/h3][p]
Saving lives is your top priority. Communicate with your squad, assess the situation, and keep an eye out for civilians in need. Vehicles with aerials, like ladders or platforms, are essential for reaching victims in hard-to-access places.

Once you’ve found someone, escort them to safety – there’s always an ambulance on site, ready to assist and treat the injured.


[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45535639/00ea43b4611504598f252131880b5daef97a99ec.jpg"][/img]
[/p][h3][b]💦 UNITED AGAINST FIRE.[/b][/h3][p]
Just as critical as saving lives is fighting the fire itself. Use the right extinguishing agents to handle a variety of scenarios – ordinary fires, grease fires, liquid fires, gas fires, and electrical fires all require different approaches. Choose wisely, act fast, and save the day.


[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45535639/7652d6b9caa88b9c5ce3ea92ab3080f715e7e446.jpg"][/img]
[/p][h3][b]🎙️ Call the Shots.[/b][/h3][p]
Going solo with an NPC crew? No problem. Use intuitive squad commands to direct your NPC teammates: assign general tasks like “extinguish fires” or “search and rescue,” or use context-sensitive commands to target specific hazards in the scene.

NPC firefighters will do their best to follow your lead and will notify you if they encounter obstacles – like lacking the proper tool for the job.


[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45535639/7901d77b1b6b89e5e3eb96d7096282ef998e082c.jpg"][/img]
[/p][h3][b]🚨 Ready to roll out?[/b][/h3][p]
Want to join the squad? Be sure to wishlist Firefighting Simulator: Ignite on Steam and follow us on Social Media for the latest news, announcements, and behind-the-scenes content. Join the community on Discord to share your excitement with fellow firefighting fans and give us your feedback! We can’t wait to hear what you’re most looking forward to! 💌


[/p][list][*][p][url="https://www.facebook.com/FirefightingSimulator"]Facebook[/url][/p][/*][*][p][url="https://www.instagram.com/firefighting_simulator/"]Instagram[/url][/p][/*][*][p][url="https://www.threads.net/@firefighting_simulator"]Threads[/url][/p][/*][*][p][url="https://www.tiktok.com/@astragon_entertainment"]TikTok[/url][/p][/*][*][p][url="https://discord.gg/astragon"]Discord[/url][/p][/*][*][p][url="https://www.firefighting-simulator.com"]Website[/url][/p][/*][/list][p]

Stay tuned and get ready to gear up for the fight against fire!

[b]Your Firefighting Simulator Team 🧑‍🚒[/b]
[/p]

notes.title: Gear Up – Firefighting Simulator: Ignite is coming!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45535639/07e288be8552ec9a9ad8a3df0cd1cff25552f514.jpg[/img]

[b]Attention all heroes! [/b]

We’re thrilled to announce [b]Firefighting Simulator: Ignite[/b], our  upcoming immersive firefighting experience. It’s time to gear up for the adrenaline-fueled world of firefighting – [b]coming this Fall to Steam.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45535639/e7f6806b158137712436642d92ed175b5250ecb1.jpg[/img]

[h3][b]🔥United Against Fire. [/b][/h3]

Face unpredictable dangers head-on, fight perilous fires with your crew, and save lives in [b]Firefighting Simulator: Ignite[/b]. Step into the boots of a U.S. firefighter in a sprawling city in the American Midwest, where every mission pushes your skills to the limit. 

Experience the rush of firefighting in stunning visual quality in an intuitive and cooperative multiplayer mode with 3 friends or with the help of your NPC crew members. Battle raging and dynamic flames, heat and smoke, all simulated in real-time with the cutting-edge physics and graphics systems powered by Unreal Engine 5 letting you immerse yourself in firefighting in a never-before-experienced way.

When the emergency call comes in, every second counts. Take the fastest route to the scene, gear up, and work together to fight fires and save lives. Are you ready to become a true hero?

Have a first look at [b]Firefighting Simulator: Ignite[/b] in our announcement teaser:

[previewyoutube=GDJk8v2jaHc;full][/previewyoutube]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45535639/2983950df912a841f02fa8b828de0d3fd2b5605c.jpg[/img]

[h3][b]🧯Gear up for your Shift.[/b][/h3]

With [b]Firefighting Simulator: Ignite[/b], we want to ignite your passion for the world of firefighting. Gear up for these core features:

[list]
[*][b]Be an everyday hero:[/b] Step into the boots of a U.S. firefighter
[*][b]Ignite your passion:[/b] Fight perilous fires in single- and multiplayer mode
[*][b]United against fire:[/b] Join forces with your friends in 4-player coop-mode or fill up your squad with NPC teammates 
[*][b]Be quick to respond:[/b] Drive faithfully reproduced, licensed Rosenbauer America fire trucks, such as TP3® Pumper, Viper®, 68’ Roadrunner and more
[*][b]Gear up:[/b] Use authentic equipment from leading US firefighting brands such as HAIX®, Fire-Dex, STIHL and Leatherhead Tools
[*][b]Explore the fire station:[/b] Your hub for learning techniques and choosing your next emergency missions
[*][b]Immerse yourself in the simulation:[/b] Experience a cutting-edge firefighting simulation with realistic fire, heat, water, and smoke simulation powered by Unreal Engine 5
[*][b]Mod your own:[/b] Create mods and share them via Mod.io 
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45535639/d38c4657f8e3be3ee314dd03fdc1fe6a28226c41.jpg[/img]

[h3][b]🚒 Behind the Flames.[/b][/h3]

[b]Firefighting Simulator: Ignite[/b] is published by astragon Entertainment, developed by weltenbauer. Software Entwicklung GmbH, and supported by the Federal Ministry of Economic Affairs and Climate Action. The new game from the developers of the [b]Construction Simulator[/b] franchise is powered by Unreal Engine 5 and will be available for $34.99 (or your regional equivalent) on Steam in Fall 2025. [b]Firefighting Simulator: Ignite[/b] will launch on PC and consoles, with support for crossplay. Physical copies will be available in select countries.
